title: Starting technology choices
description: The question a new game asks before the first strategy card: the Winnu choose 1 technology without prerequisites, the Argent Flight 2 of 3 (the one they leave behind stays in the deck), the Council Keleres 2 technologies that the other players start with. Mocked decisions with the options, details and context that crates/ti4-engine/src/starting_tech.rs sends; regenerate with npm run screenshots -- EP.

shots.heading: Winnu, desktop
shots.caption: Any one of the eight technologies that have no prerequisites (four base, four Prophecy of Kings). Each row shows its colour, that it needs nothing, and the printed text.

shots.heading: Argent Flight, first of two picks, desktop
shots.caption: Neural Motivator, Sarween Tools or Plasma Scoring. The title says 1 of 2 and the text says the one left behind stays in the technology deck.

shots.heading: Argent Flight, second pick, desktop
shots.caption: The pick already made is named (Sarween Tools) and only the two that remain are offered.

shots.heading: Council Keleres, desktop
shots.caption: Asked after every other seat has chosen: a non-faction technology that another player starts with, with the seats that hold it.

shots.heading: Selected, desktop
shots.caption: A row is selected and Confirm choice is enabled. Nothing is sent before it.

notes.title: Fixtures
notes.text: Synthetic: a mocked server sends the decision as the engine builds it (subtype starting_technology, option kind starting_technology, details pick/of/rule/held, option payload owners). Not a captured game.

notes.title: Not shown
notes.text: Thunder's Edge picks (Last Bastion, Crimson Rebellion, Ral Nel, Firmament, Deepwrought) use the same question; those factions cannot be seated in this build.
